articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, October 9, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it will report its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 before the U.S. financial markets open.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma to announce third quarter 2026 financial results on November 4, 2026
